input_count_correction.correction: 65,536 is the number of ordered pairs for two 8-bit operands. Two 9-bit operands require 262,144 pairs. The published descriptions use the counts in the saved exhaustive reports.

original_studies.title: A Comprehensive Model for Efficient Design Space Exploration of Imprecise Computational Blocks
original_studies.review_status: Publisher full text was not accessible during this review (HTTP 403). No paper-specific synthesis parameters or numerical results were transcribed.

original_studies.title: EvoApprox8b: Library of Approximate Adders and Multipliers for Circuit Design and Benchmarking of Approximation Methods
original_studies.review_status: Full text checked, sections III-A, III-C, and IV. The original study uses TSMC 180 nm components and estimates validated against Cadence Encounter RTL Compiler. Its reported results are distinct from this site's maintainer-reported Nangate45 flow. No paper measurements were imported into the plots.

original_studies.title: EvoApproxLib: Extended Library of Approximate Arithmetic Circuits
original_studies.review_status: Full text checked as the library-extension reference. No paper measurements or inferred synthesis settings were imported into the plots.

verification_limits: The named flow and common assumptions are maintainer-reported; the synthesis/analysis flow was not independently rerun for this site.
EvoApprox C/RTL verification flags remain source-reported because the corresponding model sources and testbenches were not supplied.

Adder delay_ns values are negative. The new flow description does not resolve whether these values denote a path delay, slack, or another timing quantity; they remain reported timing, without a sign or absolute-value conversion.
